description: This file contains unit tests for helper functions related to payload processing, heartbeat response detection, and payload extraction in a software project. It verifies the behavior of functions like pickSummaryFromPayloads, pickLastNonEmptyTextFromPayloads, pickLastDeliverablePayload, pickDeliverablePayloads, and isHeartbeatOnlyResponse.

methods.name: pickSummaryFromPayloads
methods.description: Selects a summary text from payloads, prioritizing non-error text and falling back to error message.

methods.name: pickLastNonEmptyTextFromPayloads
methods.description: Retrieves the last non-error, non-empty text payload, with fallback to error payload.

methods.name: pickLastDeliverablePayload
methods.description: Chooses the last payload that is either a real deliverable or an error, with special handling for media.

methods.name: pickDeliverablePayloads
methods.description: Filters payloads to only include successful deliverables, or the last error if no success payloads are present.

methods.name: isHeartbeatOnlyResponse
methods.description: Determines whether the response contains only heartbeat signals, with no media or other payloads indicating activity.

ctags.name: error
ctags.pattern: /^    const error = { text: "Error warning", isError: true as const };$/

ctags.name: error
ctags.pattern: /^    const error = { text: "bad", isError: true as const };$/

ctags.name: payloads
ctags.pattern: /^    const payloads = [{ text: "Real output" }, { text: "Service error", isError: true }];$/

ctags.name: payloads
ctags.pattern: /^    const payloads = [{ text: "Service error", isError: true }];$/

ctags.name: payloads
ctags.pattern: /^    const payloads = [{ text: "Tool error: rate limited", isError: true }];$/

ctags.name: text
ctags.pattern: /^      { text: "last error", isError: true as const },$/
